stubs.service: Local LLM runtime (node-llama-cpp + GGUF model weights from Hugging Face)
stubs.how: start.sh sets NODE_OPTIONS=--import=.ui-capture/stub/register.mjs; a module resolve hook maps the 'node-llama-cpp' import to .ui-capture/stub/node-llama-cpp-stub.mjs, which implements getLlama/loadModel/createContext/LlamaChatSession and streams a Qwen3-style thought segment followed by a real, topic-matched markdown answer (code, SQL, writing, etc.) over catai's normal WebSocket/HTTP chat paths. Model files in .ui-capture/catai-data/models are small placeholders.
CATAI_MODEL_INDEX points at the repo's bundled models.json (catai's own file fallback).

notes: Catai = local LLM chat server (server/, Node 22 via mise) + the new React UI (clients/catai-react), served by catai's own `catai serve --ui catai-react` on $PORT. Built by .ui-capture/build.sh (npm ci --ignore-scripts + tsc for server; vite build for the UI, copied to server/www/catai-react). Server-side data: .ui-capture/seed-server.mjs writes CATAI_DIR=.ui-capture/catai-data/app-db.json in the exact shape `catai install` produces: 5 installed models (meta-llama-3-8b, gemma-3-12b, qwen3-8b, gpt-oss-20b, qwen3-4b-thinking-2507 = active) with install dates spread over ~7 months and user-tweaked settings (temperature, topP, built-in API calls). Browser-side data: catai-react keeps chat history only in the browser (IndexedDB 'Catai'/'chatSessions' + localStorage), so the entry /seed.html (generated by .ui-capture/browser-seed/generate.mjs into the served dir) loads catai-seed.json into those same stores once, then location.replace('/') into the app. Seeded: 55 past chat sessions (62 prompts) spread over ~5 months, 1-2 turns each, short and long (coding, SQL, writing, devops, personal), recent ones with model 'thinking' segments, the prompt history (localStorage 'history'), a custom system prompt, built-in API toggles and dark theme. Main areas: left sidebar (connection status, New Chat, Settings, searchable Recent Chats with 'Load more'), chat pane (markdown/code rendering, collapsible thinking, streaming replies, inline completion), Settings modal (system prompt, built-in API toggles, JSON model settings editor saved via /api/admin/settings). Opening '/' directly shows the app without seeded history. Rebuild from scratch with .ui-capture/build.sh (needs registry network). .ui-capture/tools/ holds verification helpers only (ws-test.mjs WebSocket check, dom-check.mjs jsdom+fake-indexeddb render check); a real headless Chromium can't start inside this sandbox.
